svg.aria-label: academic-pipeline: the 10 stages, and where each stage goes now. Boxes: 1 Research: deep-research; 2 Write: academic-paper, plan or full; 2.5 Integrity check; 3 Review: academic-paper-reviewer; Back to stage 2, or end; 4 Revise: academic-paper revision; 3' Re-review; 4' Re-revise, no review after; 4.5 Final integrity check, zero issues to pass; 5 Finalize: DOCX, LaTeX, PDF; 6 Process summary; 1 Research: deep-research; 2 Write: academic-paper; 2.5 Integrity check; 3 Review; 4, 3', 4' Revise and re-review; 4.5 Final integrity check; 5 Finalize; 6 Process summary; paper full; paper-review, entry 6; researcher, entry 13: integrity and ethics checks, the stage loop; paper revision; paper format-convert, entry 5; none.
